about: The PQL corpus cases (corpus.json) the adapter is known to answer differently from the reference, each with the parts that differ: answer, validity, tree, readings, errors or warnings. pql_corpus.rs fails on any other difference, on a listed part that agrees, and on a listed id the corpus lacks, so the list can only shrink; the checkpoint's ratchet takes it only as a subset of the checkpoint's (Phase 1 design, KNOWN_DIFFERING). Empty since T1.6b.
